prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about a thin needle rotating to cover a plane with as little area as possible. Around 84 BPM, E minor. A single pizzicato line rotates through registers; prepared-piano scrapes mark each turn. Sparse, angular, ingenious. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No lush pads at first; density is geometric, not emotional swell. No trailer hits.

[00:00–00:22] One pizzicato pitch, then a second a tritone away, like a needle and its turn.
[00:22–01:05] Line rotates through a circle of fifths fragment; woodblock on each 180-degree turn.
[01:05–01:50] Multiple faint copies overlap, covering more pitch-space with little material.
[01:50–02:30] Copies collapse back to the original thin line.
